subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw advance the per-agent SQLite schema to v12 for ACP parent-stream diagnostics as part of this broader journal migration?
rationale: Repository policy requires explicit user discussion and acceptance before advancing a SQLite schema version; the supplied review context shows no maintainer decision recording that acceptance.

options.title: Approve the bounded v12 migration
options.body: Confirm that session-owned ACP diagnostics belong in the per-agent database and accept the tested v11-to-v12 upgrade path after live proof is attached.

options.title: Split ACP diagnostics from this refactor
options.body: Land the non-schema journal migrations separately and defer the ACP table/version change to a storage-owner-reviewed follow-up.
